rationale: Artem is a hands-on ML engineer with deep expertise in efficient inference, transformer architectures, and vision-language models—skills that could be valuable as Lisa explores her venture at Redbey Lakes LLC. While Lisa's current focus areas aren't well-documented publicly, her founder background combined with Artem's track record building open-source ML systems (loopvlm, PyTorch implementations) and experience across both research and applied roles creates potential for complementary skill exchange.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Lisa Wang — Artem's hands-on ML infrastructure expertise and open-source shipping track record could be a useful complement as you scale your work at Redbey Lakes.
